india.one_line: Indian enterprises scale AI adoption while the tech sector navigates workforce shifts and investment priorities.

themes.title: Enterprises scale AI adoption and partnerships
themes.text: Indian businesses are moving AI projects into full production, with Global Capability Centres and IT firms forming deployment partnerships. Meanwhile, investors are favoring IT companies that can monetize AI without heavy capital spending.

stories.headline: Oracle India says firms are moving from AI pilots to full-scale production
India's GCCs and IT firms form enterprise AI partnerships
IT firms with lower capital requirements may gain as investors shift focus to AI monetisation: Report

themes.title: AI automation threatens graduate tech jobs
themes.text: Nasscom President Rajesh Nambiar warned that entry-level coding automation could challenge new engineering graduates, prompting calls for curriculum reforms.

stories.headline: Nasscom President Rajesh Nambiar warns AI may impact tech jobs for graduates
